project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual; finely divided lower leaves and narrower upper leaves; yellow rays often with dark maroon basal blotches; pappus reduced to short scales/awns.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.leaves: Lower leaves deeply divided into narrow segments; upper leaves opposite to alternate and less dissected.
morphology_keys.heads: Rays yellow, commonly with dark reddish-brown blotches near the base; disks dark yellow to brownish.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Outer involucre of narrow bracts beneath broader inner phyllaries.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae flattened, typically with 2 short awns and small marginal teeth/scales.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
